description: Intersect provides reservoir simulation for field-development and operating studies. SLB describes flexible grids, oil and gas reservoirs, unconventional resources, carbon-dioxide storage and links with geological and production-engineering workflows. It also documents concurrent simulation through Delfi. The provider is SLB. Coverage: Coverage follows the network or reservoir supplied by the user. Spatial detail and the simulated time horizon are model settings; there is no fixed observation period. Access: The provider page describes the software and supplies a contact route for access. No executable or example model was obtained. Licence and cost: This is commercial software. The page does not establish the applicable licence agreement or a complete price; access terms must be confirmed with the provider. Limitations: Published capabilities are provider claims. No model was run and numerical accuracy was not independently tested. For infrastructure simulation it supports comparison of field development, well operation and subsurface storage scenarios. Related resources: For comparison, model-geophires-x covers geothermal project performance. The relationship is thematic; no direct software coupling is asserted.
